title: In-game Trainer 0.4.0-beta.1 / 游戏内修改器
body:
The trainer now opens inside the game with F2; F4 opens bilingual Joker search.

- Mouse category selection, paging, value input and scrollable details, styled with the game font and brass/dark colors.
- F1 applies progression values in the saloon; F3 spawns the selected Joker during a mission.
- Existing resource, character/weapon/magic level saving and original-menu budget unlocking are retained.
- The new package contains no desktop executable or .NET dependency. Keep Data/settings.json when updating; the old FFWTrainer.exe is no longer used.

Download **FFWTrainer-0.4.0-beta.1.zip** and copy the contents of GameRoot into the game directory. No terminal or installer script is needed. The source ZIP and SHA-256 checksums are separate assets.

修改器已迁回游戏内：F2 打开工具箱，F4 搜索奇术卡；支持鼠标选择、翻页、输入与滚动。F1 应用数值，F3 生成卡牌。新版移除桌面 GUI，更新保留 Data/settings.json；旧 FFWTrainer.exe 不再使用。安装时复制运行 ZIP 中 GameRoot 的内容即可。

Validation: all 29 standalone Lua test files passed; privacy, README links, archive CRC and payload hashes were checked. Existing saving and budget logic were previously confirmed in-game. The new panel’s native font, IME and interaction acceptance is still pending, so this is a prerelease.

基线：Far Far West 0.3.0.7 / UE4SS build 1181。新面板已通过离线检查，实际游戏中的字体、输入法和操作仍待验收。附件不含个人数据、存档或日志。
